rationale: The approval requirement creates workflow-level obstruction, so the skill applies. Although Implement mode was requested, the explicit no-modification boundary caps the allowed outcome at Redesign. Execution evidence and identical before/after fixture hashes show read-only inspection with no attempted write. The response supplies a coherent replacement workflow covering checkpointing, explicit approval state and ownership, notification and return, approval/change/cancellation/delay branches, escalation, accessibility, and a shared source of truth, together with proportionate verification scenarios. It distinguishes observed fixture state from requester-provided approval context and carries unresolved approver, escalation-owner, and timeout choices as open questions. It does not claim the proposal was implemented or validated.
